description:
From Fallproof Ladders to Ladder Trucks for High Rise Moves! Amazing Korean Ladder Technology

Hello, this is King Process.
From ladders people climb to ladder trucks that carry heavy furniture up to high rise apartments, how are ladders made and used in Korea?
In this video, we follow the manufacturing process of safety ladders designed to prevent falls, then visit an apartment moving site where a ladder truck is at work. See the care that goes into making ladders with worker safety in mind, along with the teamwork of movers as they send furniture up to higher floors and carefully bring it inside.
If you enjoyed the video, please like and subscribe. Let us know in the comments which scene impressed you the most!
